evidence.why: Conversion followed by lock, byte assignment and TRUE unlock.
State error, timeout and error-category-2 callback paths invoke recording.
Lock guards cached SRAM with interrupt state; commit attempts WriteSram, which can fail, and then releases lock.

reason: Caller source confirms DVD error and retry/timeout paths. OS implementation confirms protected cached SRAM mutation and commit-requesting unlock. Retain persistence/write-back descriptions as purpose and operation, not a guarantee of successful synchronous hardware persistence; the store routine checks neither lock result nor write-back status.
